title: Move an appointment to another day or time
summary: Drag the appointment to another time, or move it to another day and change its duration from the menu.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Drag the appointment or right-click it
steps.details: Drag it to another time or room: it saves when you drop it. For another day, right-click → Move to.

steps.title: Move to
steps.details: Choose the day on the calendar: the time and duration are kept.

steps.title: Duration
steps.details: Another option in the same menu: makes the appointment longer or shorter (15, 30, 45 min…). You can also stretch it from the appointment's edge.
